intent_en: Compare the nuclear warhead counts of the nine listed countries.
narration_support: But there are still enough bombs today to kill hundreds of millions of people, and more than enough to create the conditions of a nuclear winter.
chart_support: Chart with a horizontal bar and list showing nuclear warhead counts by country, with the United States and Russia having the longest bar segments.
evidence_note: Narration establishes the catastrophic threat (nuclear winter/death toll) based on the number of bombs; chart visualizes the stockpile distribution, showing the US and Russia hold the vast majority of the total count.
narrative_goal: To illustrate the massive scale of global nuclear arsenals that poses a threat of nuclear winter.
current_model_input: Compare the nuclear warhead counts of the nine listed countries.
